themes_detail.label: Park Rules Violations Spike
themes_detail.summary: Park rule violation complaints surged to 6 THIS WEEK, a 1500% spike from the 0.4 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 11.62), suggesting a sudden enforcement gap or behavioral change in Greenpoint/Williamsburg parks.
evidence: 6 park rules violation complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 11.62 indicates statistically significant anomaly
Community Board has standing request for park reconstruction/upgrades, suggesting existing facility stress
reporting_angles: What specific park rules are being violated? Interview Parks enforcement and community board members to understand the pattern.
Are there specific parks (e.g., East River Waterfront Park, McCarren Park) driving the spike? Ground reporting to identify hot spots.

themes_detail.label: Drug Activity Surge Last Week
themes_detail.summary: Drug activity complaints reached 6 LAST WEEK, a 336% increase from the 1.4 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 9.55), marking a significant safety concern in the district.
evidence: 6 drug activity complaints LAST WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 9.55 indicates severe statistical anomaly
Community Board has standing request for homeless services, which may correlate with drug activity visibility
reporting_angles: Interview NYPD about enforcement response and whether this reflects increased activity or increased reporting.
Talk to residents and local business owners about where they're observing activity and public safety impacts.

themes_detail.label: Mobile Food Vendor Complaints Explode
themes_detail.summary: Mobile food vendor complaints spiked to 4 TWO WEEKS AGO, a 3100% jump from the 0.1 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 11.72), suggesting either a sudden influx of unpermitted vendors or a coordinated resident reporting campaign.
evidence: 4 mobile food vendor complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 11.72 indicates extreme statistical outlier
No follow-up spike data this week suggests this may have been a one-time event or resolved quickly
reporting_angles: Did a specific vendor or group of vendors move into the district? Check with Department of Health or Parks enforcement.
Were residents responding to a known unpermitted vendor operation, or is there a seasonal factor (weather improving, street fairs)?

themes_detail.label: Illegal Dumping Up 151% Last Week
themes_detail.summary: Illegal dumping complaints reached 38 LAST WEEK, a 151% increase from the 15.1 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 6.51), indicating growing sanitation and environmental management problems in the district.
evidence: 38 illegal dumping complaints LAST WEEK vs. 15.1 weekly baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 6.51 confirms statistically significant spike
Correlates with spike in 'Wood Pile Remaining' complaints (3 last week vs. 0.1 baseline), suggesting construction/demolition debris specifically
reporting_angles: Map the 38 complaints to identify geographic clusters—are certain blocks or waterfront areas becoming dumping sites?
Investigate the wood pile spike (2300% increase last week): Are active construction sites inadequately secured? Talk to DOB enforcement.

themes_detail.label: Air Quality Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: Air quality complaints surged to 12 LAST WEEK, a 284% increase from the 3.1 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 6.11), potentially driven by the illegal dumping and wood pile spikes or external pollution events.
evidence: 12 air quality complaints LAST WEEK vs. 3.1 weekly baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 6.11 indicates significant environmental concern
Temporal overlap with illegal dumping (+151%), wood pile (+2300%), and illegal fireworks (+1100% two weeks ago) suggests multiple pollution sources
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Department of Environmental Protection to cross-reference with air monitoring data for the district.
Interview residents who filed complaints about air quality to identify specific sources (burning, dust, odors) and locations.
